name: Shingeki no Megami
source:
A fan story that pairs the protagonist, a college student from our modern world, with Krista (Historia) in the world of T*tans. Get close to your team... get intimate!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151046.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一篇同人故事，将来自现代世界的大学生主人公与泰坦世界中的克里斯塔（希斯特利亚）配成一对。接近你的队友……与她亲密起来！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151046.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
